maya: Heads-up: company migration from Jira -> GitHub Issues announced. Full plan: https://redwood-internal/repo/devex/jira-to-gh (read before dry-run).

maya: Important dates: dry-run export Tue 2026-05-05, read-only freeze 2026-05-12 00:00 UTC, final import + cutover 2026-05-15 02:00-06:00 UTC. Expect write freeze during cutover.

noah: Will old Jira links break for docs and PRs?

maya: We9ll maintain a redirector so common Jira URLs 301 -> GH issues when possible. Attachments will be copied to our S3 archive and referenced. Mapping table is in the doc.

rita: Who owns translating automations (sprints, severities, custom fields)?

maya: DevEx + Eng-Infra will handle core mappings (sprint->milestone, severity->labels). Custom fields that don9t map will be frozen and listed for manual rebuild; we9ll provide GH Actions + templates to replicate key flows.

deploy-bot: issue-migrate v1.2 dry-run started by @maya at 1807605400 500 issues scanned, 5 warnings.

tom: CI note: some pipelines use JIRA keys in commit hooks. Any recommended replacement?\

maya: Replace those with a lookup helper in actions/utils which converts old-key -> issue URL, or use the GH Issues API directly. Example curl in the doc. We will publish a migration PR template for pipelines.

security-bot: Reminder: SCIM provisioning unchanged but team mappings require review.

noah: Can we request exception edits during freeze if a production runbook needs a change?

maya: Yes, emergency edits allowed via tracked requests to #eng-oncall; Eng-Infra will apply them. Add any exception requests to the "freeze exceptions" section in the doc by EOD Friday.

rita: I can help QA migrated issues for product-ui projects.

maya: Thanks 5 volunteers noted. Action items: 1) read migration doc, 2) sign up for spot-checks, 3) join dry-run sync Tue 10:00 UTC (invite soon). Post dry-run logs to this thread. :calendar: :rocket:
